basis: Lymphatic vessel malformation; chronic skin hyperkeratosis, erosion and scarring occur in 30-79%. Dystonia ancestors contradict the definition.
Inherited intestinal brush-border carbohydrate enzyme deficiency, even without clinical sucrose intolerance; no additional organ damage established.
Skeletal deformity 2/2, respiratory failure 2/2, sensorineural hearing loss 1/1; strabismus 2/2 omitted at cap. Reflux lacks injury evidence; cohorts tiny.
Syndromic intellectual disability; strabismus 13/21 and hypermetropia 7/21 support ocular involvement; brachydactyly 12/21. Hearing impairment 4/18 is below threshold.
Thrombotic dermal microvasculopathy causes chronic ulcers and scarring. Associated thrombophilia, autoimmunity and infections do not establish additional direct organ damage.
Structural corneal thinning and ectasia impair vision; disease is confined to the eye.
Hereditary ataxia with pyramidal spasticity; additional organ damage is not established across this umbrella.
B-cell immunodeficiency and cardiomyopathy define it; neutropenia 2/3 and bronchiectasis 1/3 support involvement. Small cohorts; neurologic findings may reflect other defects.
Iris dysfunction defines the condition; its intraoperative presentation does not establish damage to another organ.
Pure personality disorder without established damage to any of the 13 organ axes.
Glycogen synthesis defect explicitly affects skeletal muscle and heart, causing myopathy and cardiac dysfunction. Seizures are occasional and do not justify another axis.
Infection of the brain, spinal cord or their coverings defines this umbrella; no additional organ is consistently affected across its subtypes.
Altitude-induced noncardiogenic pulmonary edema causes lung dysfunction. Cerebral edema is a separate concomitant disease; tachycardia does not establish heart damage.
Immature teratoma originates in the central nervous system; mixed tissue components do not imply disease in their corresponding organs.
Defined by congenital hypoplasia of the clavicles, zygomatic arches and mandible; no additional organ involvement is supplied.
Endocrine overactivity/tumors, characteristic skin lesions and cardiac myxomas are major diagnostic features. Schwannomas and skeletal lesions are occasional.
Primary breast carcinoma; breast has no axis. Metastatic organ involvement is not intrinsic to this histologic diagnosis.
Developmental disability, epilepsy, movement disorders and cortical malformations define a neurologic disorder. Hypotonia and feeding difficulty do not establish other organ damage.
Aldosterone synthesis deficiency causes electrolyte and acid-base abnormalities. Renal salt wasting reflects hormone deficiency rather than intrinsic kidney damage.
Joubert brain malformation and developmental impairment define it; postaxial polydactyly occurs in 5/5 and optic nerve hypoplasia in 2/4. Oculomotor apraxia is neurologic.
Inherited glomerular basement membrane disease; hearing impairment and anterior lenticonus each occur in 30-79% in supplied HPO. Hypertension is secondary renal disease.
Abnormal glycogen metabolism causes progressive myoclonic epilepsy and neurodegeneration. Visual phenomena are cerebral; hepatic failure is not established as common.
COQ2 deficiency commonly causes nephropathy and encephalopathy, each documented in 1/1 annotated patient. Phenotype varies; low muscle CoQ10 alone does not establish muscle damage.
Isolated developmental eye disease with microphthalmia, anophthalmia and coloboma; RBP4 involvement alone does not establish a systemic metabolic disorder.
Named neurocutaneous syndrome with congenital pigmentary macules and intellectual disability, reported in 30-79%. Short stature alone does not establish skeletal disease.
